name: Agents Md
summary: Use when the requested deliverable includes creating, reviewing, moving, splitting, or updating a repository AGENTS.md; produces scoped repo guidance. Do not trigger for standalone skills, prompts, non-AGENTS instruction files, READMEs, changelogs, or architecture docs.

name: Make Documentation
